title.zh: Fed Proposes Capital Charges and Bank Approval Rules for Stablecoins
title.en: Fed Proposes Capital Charges and Bank Approval Rules for Stablecoins

current_state.zh: The Federal Reserve proposed capital charges and bank approval rules for stablecoin issuers, requiring covered issuers to generally redeem tokens within two business days and applying the GENIUS Act's 120-day decision clock to bank applications.
current_state.en: The Federal Reserve proposed capital charges and bank approval rules for stablecoin issuers, requiring covered issuers to generally redeem tokens within two business days and applying the GENIUS Act's 120-day decision clock to bank applications.
